crossRefs.note: The destroyer will come on every city, and no city will escape; the valley also will perish, and the plain will be…
therefore, behold, I will open the side of Moab from the cities, from his cities which are on his frontiers, the glory…
Therefore as I live, says Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, surely Moab will be as Sodom, and the children of Ammon…
Out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with its pasture lands, Jahaz with its pasture lands,
Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands: four cities.
Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their…

people.name: Jahaz
people.line: A town in Moab, site of Israelite victories

people.name: Mephaath
people.line: A Levitical city in Reuben, later Moabite

translations.web: Judgment has come on the plain country, on Holon, on Jahzah, on Mephaath,
translations.bsb: Judgment has come upon the high plain— upon Holon, Jahzah, and Mephaath,
translations.kjv: And judgment is come upon the plain country; upon Holon, and upon Jahazah, and upon Mephaath,
translations.asv: And judgment is come upon the plain country, upon Holon, and upon Jahzah, and upon Mephaath,
